param_input_item.param_description: a string scalar or row character vector: Markdown text to render.

description.p: markdowndisp renders Markdown text and LaTeX equations in the GUI Command Window.
When Nelson is not running with the GUI Command Window, markdowndisp displays the input text with disp.

example_item.example_item_data:
mdText = sprintf([ ... '## LaTeX Rendering Test

', ... '**Fraction and exponent:**

', ... '$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}$

', ... '**Sum:**

', ... '$\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$

', ... '**Integral:**

', ... '$\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$

', ... '**Matrix:**

', ... '$A = \begin{bmatrix} a_{11} & a_{12} \\ a_{21} & a_{22} \end{bmatrix}$

', ... '**Limit and Greek letters:**

', ... '$\lim_{\theta \to 0} \frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1, \quad \alpha + \beta = \gamma$

', ... '**Inline equation:** energy $E = mc^2$ and Euler identity $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$.
' ... ]);
markdowndisp(mdText)
